spec: DESIGN.md — installations, the machine seam, standalone save cards (issue #181)
description: Azahar's save answer where the question names a 3DS image: the program id and the extdata id its headers state (atlas/n3ds_rom.py), and the title's data directory and extdata directory stated as one unit, own-folders-by-archive-root — or the save_id hole where no title is read.

vectors.name: azahar-a-card-image-names-the-titles-save-and-extdata-as-one-unit
vectors.rationale: The question names a .3ds card image (NCSD) whose partition 0 NCCH states program id 0004000000113200 (the u64 at 0x118, ReadProgramId, ncch_container.cpp:680-689 at Azahar 2126.1.1) and whose extended header grants extdata id 0000000000001132 (ReadExtdataId, :692-722). Both directories hold the game's writes: title/00040000/00113200/data with 00000001/ and 00000001.metadata, and extdata/00000000/00001132 with user/ and boss/. The answer is the data directory with needs empty, its unit own-folders-by-archive-root mapping data and extdata to the two directories, and a second per-game-directory group for the extdata directory.

vectors.name: azahar-an-extdata-id-under-extended-access-is-the-first-listed
vectors.rationale: The image's extended header uses extended savedata access, so ReadExtdataId takes the first non-zero of the six 20-bit ids it lists (ncch_container.cpp:700-718 at Azahar 2126.1.1) — 0000000000000B8B here, spelled uppercase in the extdata path the game opens (archive_extsavedata.cpp:189). The extdata caveat says the id is the first of several.

vectors.name: azahar-an-ncch-executable-is-read-the-same-way
vectors.rationale: A .cxi is an NCCH — the program itself, its magic at 0x100 (AutoOpenNCCHNCSD, ncch_container.cpp:120-133). Its header and extended header read as a card's partition 0 does, and the answer is the same unit.
